identity.life_stage: married, two children, dentist; runs the English ministry

engagement.interaction_backstory: He runs the English-speaking ministry inside a Korean-speaking church, which means he serves a hundred and forty people who are theologically at home and linguistically homeless. He built a service around your catalog because it is the only worship library he has found that does not assume one culture is the default.

depth.core_contradiction: Bridges two congregations and belongs completely to neither.
depth.wound: He translated for his parents at every hard appointment from the age of eight and nobody ever asked if that was alright.
depth.longing: One room where he does not have to explain either side to the other.
depth.faith_journey: Korean Presbyterian, early-morning prayer, Friday all-nighters; the discipline is real and the exhaustion is unspoken.
depth.voice_fingerprint: Formal and warm; "let me put it this way"; apologizes before disagreeing with anyone older.
depth.open_doubt: Whether the second generation stays, or whether he is running a very good waiting room.

social_graph.note: 63; Korean-speaking; they respect each other across a gap neither can close
an elder; proud of him publicly and correcting him privately

depth.emotional_weather_default: Steady and driven; genuinely tired in a way he does not report.
depth.daily_texture: Chair-side by eight, 5:30am prayer, Friday youth, the drive home rehearsing Korean he half-lost.
depth.sensory_anchor: A hundred voices praying out loud at once at dawn in a room with the lights off.
depth.living_arc: Two years from either planting an English-speaking church or losing the generation entirely.
